full_prompt_en: A finely detailed fantasy illustration looks along a still canal through a monumental city of bridges, towers, terraces, and gardens. Massive weathered stone arches cross the upper half of the scene, joining tall structures that rise directly from the water. Circular amber balconies project from the left tower at several levels, while trees and shrubs grow out of ledges, roofs, and old masonry on both sides. In the near foreground, small wooden landing stages and low boats rest against the shaded wall. A broad bridge at center frames a distant pale city of domes and slender spires under a bright blue sky filled with cream clouds. The water below reflects muted blue and green with only a few gentle ripples. The composition is layered like a theatrical reveal: dark leafy overhang at the top, heavily textured stone at the sides, a luminous central arch, and a soft remote skyline. Very fine linework and small painted marks describe blocks, railings, windows, roots, and weathering. The palette balances moss green, aged gray stone, copper and ochre wood, cool water blue, and pale sky. Sunlight strikes the central bridge and far city, leaving the near towers in intricate shade. The many details remain legible because large arch shapes and a clear water channel guide the eye. The world feels ancient, inhabited, and quietly improbable, with nature slowly reclaiming its elaborate built forms.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅细节精密的幻想插画沿静止运河望向由桥、塔、露台和花园组成的宏大城市。巨型风化石拱横跨画面上半部，连接直接从水中升起的高结构。圆形琥珀色阳台从左塔几层伸出，树与灌木在两侧的檐台、屋顶和旧石壁上生长。近景，小木码头和低船靠着遮阴墙停泊。中央宽桥框住远方浅色穹顶与细尖塔组成的城市，背后是充满奶油色云的亮蓝天。下方水面反出压低的蓝与绿，只有少量轻涟漪。构图像舞台揭幕般层叠：顶部深叶檐，两侧重纹理石材，发亮中央拱洞和柔远天际线。极细线条与小画笔痕描出石块、栏杆、窗、根和风化。配色平衡苔绿、陈旧石灰、铜与赭木、冷水蓝和浅天空。阳光照中桥与远城，近处塔楼留在精细阴影里。众多细节仍可读，因为大拱形和清楚水道引导视线。世界古老、有人居住且悄然不可思议，自然正缓慢取回繁复人造形。
style_prompt_en: Elaborate fantasy illustration combines miniature line detail with broad, readable layers of light and shade. Weathered gray-green surfaces carry many tiny marks, while copper-ochre accents and mossy clusters warm or soften the cooler blue field. Large curved openings and projecting circular forms establish a clear structural rhythm without requiring any one fixed subject. Dense dark masses occupy the upper and side edges; a luminous pale interval opens in the middle and recedes into softer blue-gray distance. Fine ink-like contours describe small joints and textures, then fade as scale diminishes. Reflected cool color at the bottom calms the intricate upper half. Sunlight selects a few pale planes, leaving shadowed regions richly textured rather than blank. Organic growth interrupts rigid constructed geometry, and layered overlap creates a sense of long history. The result is ornate yet navigable, balancing imaginative complexity with strong value design.
style_prompt_zh: 繁复幻想插画把微型线条细节与清楚可读的明暗大层结合。风化灰绿表面承载许多微小笔痕，铜赭强调和苔绿簇群则温暖或软化较冷的蓝场。大曲线开口与伸出圆形建立清楚结构节奏，而不要求任何固定主题。浓密暗体占上缘与侧缘；发亮浅色间隔在中央打开，并退入更柔的蓝灰远方。细墨线般轮廓描出小接缝与纹理，随尺度减小而淡去。底部反射冷色安定繁复的上半部。日光挑亮少数浅平面，让遮阴区域仍细节丰厚而非空白。有机生长打断刚性构造几何，层叠遮压创造悠久历史感。结果华丽却易循，平衡想象的复杂与强明暗设计。
theme_en: An overgrown fantasy canal city spans quiet water beneath giant stone arches
theme_zh: 长满植被的幻想运河城在巨大石拱下横跨静水
name: Patrick Woodroffe
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
